title: Executable protocol reference: schemas, canonical digests and invariants
scope: The Python reference implementation of the OpenBody protocol: pinned JSON schemas, the canonical digest form, admitted observation shape, and the protocol invariants that keep observation, inference, simulation and clinical assertion distinct kinds.
assumptions: The canonical form is json.dumps(sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'), ensure_ascii=False); every digest in the protocol is over that form.
This is the reference against which the native iOS and Android consumers are tested, so a change here changes their corpora too.

verification.description: The whole reference suite, including 49 protocol-invariant and 48 admitted-observation cases.

known_failures: 8 tests are skipped and the count above is passing tests only.
A reference implementation establishes that the protocol is executable and self-consistent. It establishes nothing about the clinical validity of anything expressed in it.
The reference is the oracle for the native consumers, so a defect here would be mirrored rather than caught by them.
